data.one_liner: Plugin to access device location on Android, iOS, and Web
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to request location permission, get the current location, and subscribe to real‑time location and service status streams. It supports foreground and background location on all three platforms.
use_when: When you need to request location permission and get the current location
When you need continuous location updates via a stream
When you need to monitor location services status changes
avoid_when: When you only need a one‑time location without permission handling
When you need advanced geofencing or mapping features
strengths: Real‑time streams for location and service status
weaknesses: No built‑in mapping or geofencing features
data.setup_notes: Add Android permissions (ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, optional ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION) to AndroidManifest.xml; add iOS usage descriptions to Info.plist; no build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: More mature, widely used, and includes additional features like geofencing and distance calculations
